page.layout: One page of handwritten text, all in one column. Top: marginal-style references in the upper lines, then a short quotation. Below: a heading-like attribution and a paragraph running to the lower third. No printed page number, running head or catchword.

main_text.p: g. Aug. Lib. 2. Contra Lite. petili.
Confer Donatistas Eglij contemptores cum crucifixoribus Christi.
illi, inquit, persecuti sunt carnem ambulantis in terra; vos Eum sedentis in caelo.
Qui contradicunt Christo magis le dunt quam qui illum crucifixerunt.
main_text.head: Aug. de verbo Domini.
main_text.p: Quid est ista cupiditas [?] Concupiscentiae, cum ei ipse ecclie [?] sabeant modum. Tunc enim rapiunt, quando sitiunt, parum vero prodest cum senserint satietatem. Insatiabilis est sola avaritia diuitiarum, semper rapit, et nunquam satiatur, nec Deum timet, nec hominem reuerentur [?], nec patri parcit, nec matrem agnoscit, nec fratri obtemperat.

page.notes: Handwritten manuscript, not a printed page. Many words are doubtful because of the cursive hand and the faded ink; the marked words are my best reading. The opening line "g. Aug." may stand for "S. Aug." and the number "cap. 87" is read with uncertainty. The paragraph's first words, the phrase "cum ei ipse ecclie sabeant modum", and the verb "reuerentur" are the least certain. The left margin has no text. Show-through or stains are not transcribed.
